note: Humboldt County Conservation Board park (state-owned land leased to county, run by Humboldt CCB) at the confluence of the East and West Forks of the Des Moines River, 4 mi S of Humboldt. Wooded river park with bike-trail access, a camp host and a boat ramp; the camp area is set back in timber, not on the bank. --Claude
summary: All confirmed: $20, FCFS, 32 water + electric sites; season Apr 15-Oct 15, showers and dump added. Pin about 500 m off.
flags: PIN about 500 m off: stored 42.6743,-94.2045 is on a trail along the river in an open meadow, with no campground there. Campground is at 42.6778,-94.2003 on Esri z19 (loop road and pads with RVs around the cross; I can see the pads).

Not waterfront holds on what I can see: main pads are about 70-100 m from the East Fork through timber at 42.6778,-94.2003. A lane east of the main loop at about 42.6778,-94.1995 runs within about 35 m of the river, under canopy; I can't tell whether it holds campsites (the county publishes no site map on the pages read). Lead only if a site photo places pads there.

Amperage is not stated on the pages read; hookups.electric stays unset. Page gives 8 seasonal sites in addition to the 32, which the county site calls '8 Full Hook-Up Campsites that may be rented on a seasonal basis' (stored inclusion evidence reads 30 FHU, which is not what either page says). Nightly public sites are in the majority; mostly transient.
humboldtcounty.iowa.gov page is stale ('2014 Rates are $15.00 Electric and $10.00 Non-electric', footer 2020); mycountyparks is the current one. Phone 515-890-7483 confirmed.
